summary: Myrtle Beach is a vibrant coastal destination offering miles of sandy beaches, world-class golf courses, and family-friendly attractions perfect for relaxation and adventure. Known for its lively boardwalk, diverse dining scene, and stunning Atlantic Ocean views, it provides excellent value and accessibility for travelers of all budgets.

restaurants.name: Lee's Inlet Kitchen
restaurants.description: A Myrtle Beach institution since 1948 serving fresh seafood and local favorites in a casual waterfront setting. Their low-country boil and crab cakes are legendary among locals.

restaurants.name: Croissants Bisterry & Cafe
restaurants.description: Charming French-inspired cafe offering affordable pastries, sandwiches, and coffee in a cozy boardwalk location. Perfect for breakfast or quick lunch.

restaurants.name: Sea Captain's House
restaurants.description: Beachfront restaurant with oceanview dining and a diverse menu featuring seafood, steaks, and local specialties. Known for generous portions and stunning sunset views.

restaurants.name: Carrabba's Italian Grill
restaurants.description: Contemporary Italian restaurant offering handmade pastas, wood-grilled meats, and an extensive wine selection in a warm atmosphere. Located conveniently along the Grand Strand.

restaurants.name: The Waccamaw River Oyster Roast
restaurants.description: Casual riverside venue serving freshly roasted oysters, seafood, and traditional Carolina fare with a fun, social dining experience. Family-friendly and budget-conscious.

restaurants.name: Croissants Cafe & Bakery
restaurants.description: Popular breakfast and lunch spot offering fresh-baked goods, sandwiches, and salads at affordable prices. Ideal for starting your day before beach activities.

restaurants.name: Pinnacle Restaurant
restaurants.description: Upscale fine dining establishment featuring contemporary American cuisine with seasonal ingredients and an impressive wine list. Elegant atmosphere perfect for special occasions.

restaurants.name: Barefoot Landing Seafood
restaurants.description: Casual waterfront restaurant specializing in fresh local seafood and coastal cuisine with outdoor seating and live entertainment. Great for families and groups.

restaurants.name: New York Prime Steakhouse
restaurants.description: Sophisticated steakhouse offering prime cuts of beef, fresh seafood, and an extensive wine collection in an upscale ambiance. Perfect for romantic dinners.

restaurants.name: The Waccamaw Riverfront Cafe
restaurants.description: Casual waterfront eatery serving traditional Low Country cuisine and fresh seafood at reasonable prices with scenic river views.

restaurants.name: Sea Blue Restaurant
restaurants.description: Contemporary seafood restaurant offering fresh catches prepared with innovative techniques and complemented by an excellent wine selection. Oceanview dining available.

restaurants.name: The Tap Room
restaurants.description: Casual sports bar and grill serving burgers, sandwiches, wings, and craft beers in a relaxed, friendly atmosphere. Great for casual meals and socializing.
restaurants.mustTry: Loaded Nachos and Local Craft Beer

activities.name: Myrtle Beach Boardwalk
activities.description: A 1.4-mile scenic boardwalk featuring shopping, dining, entertainment, and direct beach access with an iconic amusement park and arcade. Perfect for strolling, people-watching, and enjoying the ocean breeze.

activities.name: Huntington Beach State Park
activities.description: Pristine beach park offering swimming, surfing, picnicking, and nature trails through maritime forests. One of the less crowded beaches in the area with excellent wildlife viewing opportunities.

activities.name: Barefoot Landing
activities.description: Shopping and entertainment complex on the Intracoastal Waterway featuring boutiques, restaurants, live entertainment, and scenic waterfront boardwalk. Hosts concerts and festivals year-round.

activities.name: Brookgreen Gardens
activities.description: Award-winning sculpture garden and wildlife preserve featuring over 1,400 sculptures, tranquil gardens, and walking trails along the Waccamaw River. Combines art and nature beautifully.

activities.name: Myrtle Beach Safari Golf Club
activities.description: Championship 18-hole golf course featuring open fairways, challenging holes, and well-maintained greens. Affordable rates and lessons available for all skill levels.

activities.name: Ripley's Believe It or Not Museum
activities.description: Quirky indoor attraction featuring oddities, curiosities, and interactive exhibits from around the world. Great rainy-day activity and fun for all ages.

activities.name: Dolphin-Watching Cruise
activities.description: Guided boat tours departing from the harbor offering excellent opportunities to spot dolphins, sea birds, and other marine wildlife in their natural habitat. Educational and family-friendly.

activities.name: Alligator Farm Zoo
activities.description: Interactive wildlife park featuring alligators, exotic animals, and educational shows in a natural environment. Hands-on experiences and photo opportunities with wildlife.

activities.name: Nightlife on the Strip
activities.description: Vibrant entertainment district featuring live music venues, clubs, bars, and restaurants catering to various musical tastes. Known for beach-themed nightlife and dancing.

activities.name: Biking the Beach Path
activities.description: Scenic 10+ mile beach path perfect for cycling with views of the Atlantic Ocean, salt marshes, and coastal vegetation. Bike rentals available throughout the city.

activities.name: Surfing Lessons at South Beach
activities.description: Professional surf instruction for beginners through advanced surfers at one of the area's premier beach breaks. Equipment provided and group or private lessons available.

activities.name: Myrtle Beach State Park Kayaking
activities.description: Guided kayak tours through pristine salt marshes and waterways offering wildlife viewing, photography opportunities, and peaceful nature immersion. Suitable for all skill levels.

spots.name: Myrtle Beach Pier
spots.description: Historic wooden pier extending into the Atlantic Ocean offering dramatic foreground elements, vibrant sunset colors, and dynamic wave action.

spots.name: Huntington Beach Jetty
spots.description: Rocky jetty formation creating interesting compositions with crashing waves, dramatic textures, and excellent vantage points for seascape photography.

spots.name: North Myrtle Beach Pier
spots.description: Alternative pier location with fewer crowds, excellent for capturing architectural details and creative angles of the structure against sky and water.

spots.name: Barefoot Landing Waterfront
spots.description: Scenic waterfront promenade with shops and water reflections offering urban-nature blends and colorful architectural elements at dusk.

spots.name: Brookgreen Gardens Sculpture Trail
spots.description: Outdoor art installations set against natural landscapes provide unique compositional opportunities blending sculpture, gardens, and water features.

spots.name: Myrtle Beach Boardwalk Sunrise
spots.description: Iconic boardwalk location offering foreground elements like lampposts and railings framing the rising sun over the Atlantic Ocean.

spots.name: Waccamaw River at Sunset
spots.description: Peaceful river setting with marsh grasses, distant treelines, and mirror-like water reflections creating serene landscape compositions.

spots.name: Huntington Beach Wildlife Area
spots.description: Natural preserve offering opportunities for bird photography, wildlife captures, and nature scenes with minimal urban interference.

spots.name: Ocean Boulevard Street Photography
spots.description: Vibrant main avenue featuring colorful storefronts, street vendors, tourists, and beach-culture scenes perfect for candid and street photography.

spots.name: Nighttime Boardwalk Lights
spots.description: Illuminated boardwalk with colorful lights, neon signs, and evening activity creating vibrant night photography opportunities with creative compositions.

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for expansive seascapes and pier compositions
50mm prime for street photography and detail work along the boardwalk
70-200mm telephoto for wildlife, birds, and compressed landscape perspectives
10-24mm ultra-wide for dramatic architectural and landscape shots
photography.goldenHourNotes: Myrtle Beach offers exceptional golden hour photography with warm, diffused light reflecting off the Atlantic Ocean and wet sand. The boardwalk transforms during sunset with soft-lit architecture and silhouetted crowds, while sunrise provides cleaner compositions with minimal foot traffic. Plan to arrive 30-45 minutes before official sunrise/sunset for optimal light conditions.

weather.seasonality: Spring (April-May) and fall (September-October) offer warm, sunny weather with manageable humidity and lower rainfall. Summer months are hot and humid with frequent afternoon thunderstorms, while winters are mild but can be cloudy and rainy.
weather.summary: Myrtle Beach features a subtropical climate with warm summers ideal for water activities and mild winters suitable for beach strolls. Expect increased humidity and occasional rain during summer months, with the driest conditions typically in fall.

hotels.name: Ocean Creek Resort
hotels.description: Family-friendly resort with spacious rooms, multiple pools, and beach access offering excellent value with convenient oceanfront location and on-site dining options.

hotels.name: Anderson Ocean Club & Spa
hotels.description: Upscale beachfront hotel featuring well-appointed rooms, full-service spa, fitness center, and oceanview restaurant providing comfortable accommodations with modern amenities.

hotels.name: Sea Watch Resort
hotels.description: Premiere oceanfront luxury resort offering spacious suites with balconies, multiple pools, golf courses, fine dining, and concierge services for an elevated beachfront experience.
